rationale: The PortCo transaction correctly preserved the disclosed 66.7% CIM Opportunity Zone Fund interest and the historical CIM/joint-venture period, but older attribution metadata independently inferred CIM Infrastructure Fund III and CIM Infrastructure Fund I. The reviewed evidence names CIM Opportunity Zone Fund, L.P. for the current 66.7% interest and does not support either infrastructure-fund inference. Classify the current named vehicle as DISCLOSED without linking it to an unrelated normalized fund, and classify the former period as UNRESOLVED without altering ownership history.
